requirements.text: ID3 learns pixel questions from visible labelled digits, with actual split diagrams and retained tree history
requirements.reviewRoute: Open /public/algorithm-references/index.html#digit-lab. Each node is one card in the full-screen tree, containing its sample pile and question. Score then split: the first three cards fit at 1437×789. Compare questions opens a top-right dialog; preview another pixel and confirm the main tree stays unchanged. Try a digit and Inspect open their own dialogs. Escape/close returns focus. Back/scrub inspect retained models; zoom, Fit tree and Current node navigate larger trees.
requirements.verification: 262 package tests pass; six focused ID3 tests also pass after the candidate-recommendation refinement. Checks include independent root gain/membership, zero-gain XOR, deterministic ties, absent future splits, retained records and input immutability. Local full learner: 50 Ticks, 25 nodes, training 30/30 and disjoint held-out 10/20; these small teaching sets are not a general accuracy claim. Bounded reduced-motion Chrome profiling measured one HTML replacement and 7 height flushes by Tick 6 after removing redundant renders, versus three replacements and 19 flushes before; timings are directional evidence, not machine-specific gates. Browser results, screenshots and the exact served build fingerprint are retained in test-results/algorithm-references-id3/verification.json. Automated evidence does not constitute human acceptance.
